- Registered / remit address: please confirm (street, city, state, ZIP) — we use this for tax classification and 1099s.

- PO contact: name + phone for PO clarifications (we’ll include that in the PO metadata).
- PO routing: if you have a required PO header or prefix let me know; otherwise we’ll use standard Redwood PO numbering.

- Bank/ACH: we do not accept bank details over email. Please upload bank details via our vendor portal (secure link below) or request an SFTP ticket.
- Vendor agreement: not required for standard platform spend; if legal needs a contract, we can send a standard PO/contract — let me know and I’ll loop legal.

Secure upload link: https://vendor-portal.redwood.example.com/upload?ticket=VND-8732
